title: World Cup History & Legends
description: From 1930 to 2022 — how well do you know the greatest tournament on earth?

questions.q: Which country won the 2022 FIFA World Cup in Qatar?
questions.explain: Argentina beat France on penalties after a 3–3 final.

questions.q: Which nation has won the most World Cup titles?
questions.explain: Brazil have lifted the trophy 5 times.

questions.q: Who scored the infamous 'Hand of God' goal in 1986?
questions.explain: Maradona punched the ball past England's Peter Shilton.

questions.q: Which country hosted AND won the very first World Cup in 1930?
questions.explain: Uruguay beat Argentina 4–2 in the first final.

questions.q: Who is the all-time top scorer in World Cup history?
questions.explain: Germany's Klose scored 16 goals across four tournaments.

questions.q: Which country won the 2018 World Cup in Russia?
questions.explain: France beat Croatia 4–2 in the final.

questions.q: Spain won their first and only World Cup in which year?
questions.explain: Spain beat the Netherlands 1–0 in 2010 (Iniesta's goal).

questions.q: Who won the Golden Ball as best player at the 2022 World Cup?
questions.explain: Messi won it as Argentina lifted the trophy.

questions.q: How many World Cup titles has Germany won?
Who won the 2014 World Cup, hosted in Brazil?
questions.explain: Germany beat Argentina 1–0 after extra time in Brazil.
